cues.text: Akihiko leads you into his room in the dorm. Trophies crowd the shelves, and a punching bag and a speed bag hang among the furniture.
You sit down, and Akihiko stays standing across from you.
Akihiko turns away, walks across the room and starts searching.
You get up and walk over to his desk, where the medal from his parents' parcel lies on its ribbon. Akihiko comes over and stands beside you.
Akihiko picks the medal up from his desk and hands it to you. You hang it around his neck, and he looks down at it in surprise.
